dialogue_texts: Marisa
Well, everything I went through today has been a headache. At least the mansion is quiet again.
Marisa
First, I hear about the rumors of the glohm which turned out to be true...
Marisa
And now a day at the Scarlet Devil Mansion hoping to find Flandre led to me coming home with nothing.
Marisa
I should head back to the Kozankyo Imperial Palace. I've had enough extra for one day.
Later that night...
Marisa
What a grumpy 24 hours it has been. I definitely deserved that dance break with Kourin. I'm going to sleep...
Uhh, My Majesty?
Marisa
Yeah, yeah, I hear you. What is it this time?
You have to return to the Shirogane Manor.
Marisa
Back again? What has happened now? I swear it's becoming a magnet for trouble.
Fusana's been glohmed again.
Marisa
Infected again already!? I thought I cleared the source of that mess yesterday. Who's done it now?
No clue. While I was on the way to the shrine, I noticed some other individuals had been infected!
Marisa
That sounds worse than before. If more people are actually getting sick, we've got to move fast.
This is so serious that I'm going with you this time.
Marisa
Looks like the glohm isn't just a curse anymore - it's becoming a full-blown epidemic.
Exactly! There have been confirmed cases of human-to-human transmission.
Marisa
I'm definitely in. Let's head back to your home so I can find the cause and put a stop to it, one way or another.
To be continued in The Bewildering Parallel...
